name: Ferienwohnung Rosenhof am See
beschreibung:
Wonderfully situated just moments from Lake Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Rosenhof am See provides ideal conditions for a relaxing holiday, featuring modern comfort and lovely lake vistas.

Swimmers and water sports enthusiasts will delight in the location, while mountain trails begin right on the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Rosenhof am See in Thiersee charms with immediate lake proximity and welcoming family hospitality.
